name: custom/ai_tts
description: AI-powered text-to-speech using Kokoro TTS (Rust implementation)

check-binary: bash -c 'if [ -f bin/koko ]; then echo "✓ Kokoro binary found at bin/koko"; chmod +x bin/koko; else echo "⚠ Kokoro binary not found. See installation instructions."; fi'
display-instructions: echo '1. Install the Kokoro binary (choose one method):'
echo '   Option A - Download pre-built binary (fastest):'
echo '   Option B - Build from source (requires Rust):'
echo '   Option C - Use system binary:'
download-binary: bash -c 'ARCH=$(uname -m); OS=$(uname -s | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]"); echo "Detecting platform: $OS-$ARCH"; if [ "$OS" = "darwin" ]; then OS="macos"; fi; echo "Checking for Kokoro releases..."; LATEST_URL=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/lucasjinreal/Kokoros/releases/latest | grep "browser_download_url.*koko.*$OS" | cut -d : -f 2,3 | tr -d \"); if [ -z "$LATEST_URL" ]; then echo "⚠ No pre-built binary found for $OS-$ARCH"; echo "Please build from source using: composer run build-binary"; exit 1; else echo "Downloading from: $LATEST_URL"; curl -L "$LATEST_URL" -o bin/koko && chmod +x bin/koko && echo "✓ Binary downloaded and installed to bin/koko"; fi'
build-binary: bash -c 'if ! command -v cargo &> /dev/null; then echo "Error: Rust/Cargo not found. Install from https://rustup.rs"; exit 1; fi; echo "Building Kokoro from source..."; cd /tmp && rm -rf Kokoros && git clone https://github.com/lucasjinreal/Kokoros.git && cd Kokoros && bash download_all.sh && cargo build --release && cp target/release/koko "$OLDPWD/bin/koko" && chmod +x "$OLDPWD/bin/koko" && echo "✓ Binary built and installed to bin/koko"'

scripts-descriptions.setup-directories: Create necessary directories for the module
scripts-descriptions.check-binary: Check if Kokoro binary is installed
scripts-descriptions.download-binary: Download pre-built Kokoro binary for your platform
scripts-descriptions.build-binary: Build Kokoro binary from source (requires Rust)
